nodes.summary: For $\dot x = A x + B u$ on finite-dimensional real inner product spaces $E$ (state) and $U$ (control) and $T \in \mathbb{R}$, the controllability Gramian is the operator where $B^*$ and $e^{sA^*} = (e^{sA})^*$ are adjoints. It is symmetric, and positive semidefinite for $T \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Controllability Gramian

nodes.summary: For every $\eta \in E$, In particular $\langle \eta, W_T \eta \rangle \ge 0$ for $T \ge 0$. This is Coron, *Control and Nonlinearity* (AMS 2007), Remark 1.12, for time-invariant systems.
nodes.title: Quadratic form of the Gramian

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. The system $\dot x = A x + B u$ on finite-dimensional real inner product spaces is controllable on $[0, T]$ if and only if its controllability Gramian $W_T$ is invertible.
nodes.title: Gramian criterion for controllability

nodes.summary: Let $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$, $B \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$ and $T > 0$. The system $\dot x = A x + B u$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ (with the Euclidean inner product) is controllable on $[0, T]$ if and only if for every $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$ no nonzero complex row vector $w$ satisfies $w A = \lambda w$ and $w B = 0$; equivalently, $\operatorname{rank} [\lambda I - A, B] = n$ for every $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Hautus test for controllability

nodes.summary: Let $T > 0$. The system $\dot x = A x + B u$ on finite-dimensional real inner product spaces $E$, $U$ is controllable on $[0, T]$ if and only if that is, $\operatorname{rank} [B, AB, \dots, A^{n-1} B] = n$ with $n = \dim E$. In particular, controllability on $[0, T]$ does not depend on $T > 0$.
nodes.title: Kalman rank condition

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $U$ be finite-dimensional real inner product spaces, $A : E \to E$ and $B : U \to E$ linear maps, and $T \in \mathbb{R}$. The system $\dot x = A x + B u$ is controllable on $[0, T]$ if for all $x_0, x_1 \in E$ there are a continuous control $u : \mathbb{R} \to U$ and a solution $x : \mathbb{R} \to E$ of $\dot x(t) = A x(t) + B u(t)$ with $x(0) = x_0$ and $x(T) = x_1$.
nodes.title: Controllability of a linear control system

nodes.title: Kalman condition and Hautus test for real matrices

nodes.summary: The Kalman subspace of $(A, B)$ is all of $E$ if and only if the only vector $\eta \in E$ orthogonal to $A^k B v$ for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and every $v \in U$ is $\eta = 0$. Powers $k \ge \dim E$ add nothing to the Kalman subspace, by the Cayley–Hamilton theorem.
nodes.title: Kalman rank condition, dual form

nodes.summary: For linear maps $A : E \to E$ and $B : U \to E$, the Kalman subspace is the column space of the Kalman matrix $[B, AB, \dots, A^{n-1} B]$, $n = \dim E$. The Kalman rank condition says that it is all of $E$ (Coron, *Control and Nonlinearity*, AMS 2007, Theorem 1.16, condition (1.29); Sontag, *Mathematical Control Theory*, 2nd ed., the reachability matrix $R(A, B)$ of Theorem 3).
